heading: INT. HYPERBARIC CHAMBER, HARBOR CLINIC - NIGHT

units.text: INT. HYPERBARIC CHAMBER, HARBOR CLINIC - NIGHT
A steel cylinder the colour of old pewter, bolted to the floor of a converted fish-cannery.
Portholes sweat.
Somewhere behind the walls a compressor breathes in long, patient sighs.
DR. ADAEZE OKONKWO, fifties, silver braids pinned under a surgical cap, kneels beside a gurney bolted to the chamber floor.
Her reading glasses hang on a beaded cord.
KAIMANA PELE, twenty-six, a commercial diver with shoulders like a harbour wall, lies strapped to it, skin the grey of wet slate.
His fingers claw at the air.
TOBY LINDQVIST, a gangly night nurse in oversized scrubs, hovers at the porthole outside, a radio handset pinched in his fist.
Doc. Doc, my hands. They're gone.
units.name: KAIMANA

units.text: Stay with me, Kai. Look at my face.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Pressure's dropping on the gauge. Adaeze, we're losing the seal.
units.name: TOBY
paren: through the speaker, thin and crackling

units.text: Then close it, Toby!
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Kaimana convulses.
The straps groan.
A bubble of foam gathers at the corner of his mouth.
Kai! Kaimana!
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: IOANA BALAN, sixty, in a wool coat over a nightdress, pounds on the outer hatch with the flat of both hands.
She is the diver's mother, and she has driven forty miles in slippers.
Let me in! He is my son!
units.name: IOANA

units.text: Mrs. Balan, step back from the hatch!
units.name: TOBY

units.text: Nobody opens that door!
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Ma?
units.name: KAIMANA

units.text: Oxygen up to one hundred. Now, Toby.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Breathe, Kai, slow, in through the nose!
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: I can't, I can't, Doc, it's too tight!
units.name: KAIMANA

units.text: A valve shrieks.
The needle shivers, climbs, steadies.
The compressor finds its rhythm again and the whole cylinder seems to exhale.
Kaimana's back arches once, then settles against the gurney.
His fingers uncurl.
Colour seeps back into his face like tea into water.
I felt that. My hands. I felt that.
units.name: KAIMANA

units.text: Good. Keep feeling.
units.name: ADAEZE

units.text: Adaeze sits back on her heels.
She lets her glasses fall against her chest and presses both palms to her eyes.
Gauge is holding, Adaeze. We're okay.
units.name: TOBY

units.text: Outside the porthole, Ioana stops pounding.
She lays her forehead against the cold glass and says something in Romanian to no one.
Slava Domnului.
units.name: IOANA
